title: Wren and the Gravity
author: Zephyrine Whitlock
blurb: Kestrel Villalobos, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
